2610.07706.title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
2610.07706.paper_summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .
2610.07706.paper_summary_zh: 自回歸大型語言模型（LLMs）在能力上迅速進步，但其日益增長的規模在推斷時帶來了可觀的計算和記憶成本。知識蒸餾（KD）通過對離散概率分佈的對齊，提供了一種實用的解決方案，將知識從大型教師模型轉移到較小的學生模型。然而，現有的 LLM 知識蒸餾方法主要依賴於評估每個詞彙索引的概率值之間差異的發散，並未明確利用令牌級的語義信息。我們提出了基於 Wasserstein 的知識蒸餾（WASD），該方法通過源自令牌嵌入的成本矩陣，利用基於 Wasserstein 的距離引入令牌級的語義信息。為了確保計算的可行性，我們採用了 Sinkhorn 發散，並推導出一個梯度等價的目標，該目標可以有效地優化，而無需引入額外的網絡。在多個 LLM 家族和規模上的實驗顯示，WASD 在包括指令跟隨、數學推理和代碼生成等多樣任務上，始終提高了蒸餾性能。我們的結果突顯了在 LLM 蒸餾中，令牌空間中編碼的語義信息對有效分佈對齊的重要性。實現已公開可用於 https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD 。
